themes.theme: Legislation and Scope of the Letting Fees Ban
themes.reason: States the basic implementation vehicle (primary legislation) for the ban, but is a brief procedural statement rather than a developed argument about method choice or alternatives.
Explores a related but distinct policy question (deposit affordability) that is adjacent to the fees ban rather than part of the core implementation mechanism for enforcing the fee ban itself.
Defines the scope of what is and isn't banned, a necessary design detail, but this is about the substance of the ban's boundaries rather than the implementation/enforcement method itself.

themes.theme: Enforcement Mechanisms and Local Authority Role
themes.reason: This is the central proposed delivery mechanism (local authorities/Trading Standards enforcing the ban), explaining why this method was chosen and what support it may need - the case for implementation rests on this choice.

themes.theme: Tenant Awareness, Empowerment and Dispute Resolution
themes.reason: Explains a key complementary enforcement route (tenant-driven challenge and reporting) that is presented as essential to reducing burden on local authorities and making the ban workable, forming a core pillar of the implementation approach.
Describes a potential enhancement to enforcement but is presented as an exploratory option rather than a foundational element the implementation case depends on.

Presents an alternative/additional enforcement model (lead authority) with detailed precedent, representing a genuine alternative method under consideration that bears on how enforcement will be structured - core to the 'other methods considered' aspect.

themes.theme: Wider Regulation of the Lettings Sector
themes.reason: Discusses broader regulatory measures beyond the fee ban itself; this is an adjacent policy consideration rather than core to how the fee ban specifically will be implemented.

Details the sanctions regime (civil vs criminal, fine levels) that gives enforcement teeth, explaining the costs/benefits and design choices underpinning how the ban will be enforced - a core support for the implementation argument.
